minutes.headline: Sewer Commission waived a $143.31 unpaid interest/invoice difference at 18 Kirby Avenue; business manager search is back to square one.
minutes.summary: The commission approved three sets of minutes, then took up a final sewer invoice at 18 Kirby Avenue where the property had sold twice and the prior owner's last bill went unpaid; the difference was waived. The DPW director reported on second quarter billing, a failed business manager search after a candidate withdrew, the awarded manhole repair bid, line repairs, and a member who never attended. A roll call was taken late and the meeting adjourned.

what_happened.line: The Sewer Commission voted to waive the unpaid interest and difference on a final sewer invoice at 18 Kirby Avenue, left unpaid by previous owners.
The commission chose to waive the difference rather than pursue the prior owner, and sent the vote to the treasurer's office to adjust billing.
The business manager search has no resolution after a candidate withdrew; the requested pay was above the offer being considered.
The DPW director reported second quarter billing is being prepared, and the manhole repair bid was awarded with the work likely in spring.
The matter of a member who never attended goes to a future agenda, and the next meeting was set as a hybrid session on December 10.

why_it_matters: Sewer bills are tied to the property and the customer record, so a bill missed at a sale can leave a gap that the commission then chooses whether to collect or write off.
The business manager post is still unfilled, which leaves sewer billing and administration without that position while the search restarts.
The manhole repair is committed to its funding and scheduled for spring, so it does not depend on a new vote.
watch_next: December 10 hybrid meeting, the next one set, where the absent-member matter is expected on a future agenda.
The HR Director's answer on whether the withdrawn business manager candidate may be contacted.
